Basis for proposed SDG factor ratings
SDG 8: Structured work records, correction paths, role-based access and billing preparation support accountable workplace administration. Productivity and wage impact are unmeasured.
SDG 9: React, Express and MySQL integrate workforce, review and finance workflows. Ratings reflect documented engineering capabilities rather than a measured infrastructure impact.
SDG 12: Digital records and reusable reports may reduce paper and duplicate artifacts. Environmental and cost savings have not been measured.
SDG 16: Authorization boundaries, approval reasons and audit history support traceable decisions. Wider institutional impact has not been measured.
Quality-factor scores are qualitative estimates for this workbook, not test results or certified SDG attainment. Confirm the proposed ratings with the project guide.
